meaning.en: to be attracted to someone (often from a distance, without saying so)
meaning.de: sich zu jemandem hingezogen fühlen (oft aus der Ferne, ohne es zu sagen)

equivalent.tr: birinden hoşlanmak, birine tutulmak, platonik olmak
equivalent.de: in jemanden verknallt sein, für jemanden schwärmen

literal.en: crush = to squash; an overpowering feeling

usage.en: have a (huge/little) crush on sb · my crush (the person I like)
usage.tr: have a (huge/little) crush on sb · my crush (hoşlandığım kişi)

sentences.en: I had a huge [crush on] him in high school.
sentences.de: In der Schule war ich total in ihn verknallt.

sentences.en: I think she's got a [crush on] you.
sentences.de: Ich glaube, sie ist in dich verknallt.

meaning.en: to be attracted to or interested in someone
meaning.de: sich zu jemandem hingezogen fühlen oder an jemandem interessiert sein

variety.en: be into: AmE + BrE · fancy sb: BrE
variety.tr: be into: AmE + BrE · fancy sb: BrE

usage.en: be (really/so) into sb/sth — also for hobbies: "I'm into climbing." · "He's just not that into you." · BrE: fancy sb; also "Do you fancy a drink?" = would you like one?
usage.tr: be (really/so) into sb/sth — hobiler için de: "I'm into climbing." · "He's just not that into you." · BrE: fancy sb; ayrıca "Do you fancy a drink?" = canın ister mi?

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure he's [into you] — he keeps finding excuses to talk to you.
sentences.tr: Bence senden hoşlanıyor, seninle konuşmak için sürekli bahane buluyor.
sentences.de: Ich bin ziemlich sicher, dass er auf dich steht – er sucht ständig Vorwände, mit dir zu reden.

sentences.en: Do you [fancy] him or not?
sentences.de: Stehst du nun auf ihn oder nicht?

meaning.en: (1) to fall in love with someone (2) to be taken in by a lie or trick
meaning.tr: (1) birine âşık olmak (2) bir yalana/numaraya kanmak
meaning.de: (1) sich in jemanden verlieben (2) auf eine Lüge oder einen Trick hereinfallen

equivalent.de: sich in jemanden verlieben; auf etwas hereinfallen

usage.en: fall for sb (inseparable) · fall in love with sb · fall out of love · fall for a trick/lie/it
usage.tr: fall for sb (ayrılmaz) · fall in love with sb · fall out of love · fall for a trick/lie/it

sentences.en: I [fell for] her the first time we talked.
sentences.de: Ich habe mich schon beim ersten Gespräch in sie verliebt.

sentences.en: I can't believe I [fell for] that excuse.
sentences.de: Ich kann nicht glauben, dass ich auf diese Ausrede hereingefallen bin.

equivalent.de: Hals über Kopf verliebt sein, bis über beide Ohren verliebt sein

literal.en: head above heels (having done a somersault)

usage.en: be/fall head over heels (in love) (with sb) · head over heels for sb
usage.tr: be/fall head over heels (in love) (with sb) · head over heels for sb

sentences.en: He's [head over heels] for her.
sentences.de: Er ist bis über beide Ohren in sie verliebt.

sentences.en: They fell [head over heels] in love within a month.
sentences.tr: Bir ay içinde birbirlerine sırılsıklam âşık oldular.
sentences.de: Sie haben sich innerhalb eines Monats Hals über Kopf verliebt.

meaning.tr: birine ya da bir şeye bayılmak
meaning.de: jemanden oder etwas über alles mögen

equivalent.de: verrückt nach jemandem sein, auf etwas total stehen

variety.en: crazy about: AmE + BrE · mad about: BrE
variety.tr: crazy about: AmE + BrE · mad about: BrE

usage.en: be crazy/mad about sb/sth. The negative is a polite way to show dislike: "I'm not crazy about it." = I don't love it.
usage.tr: be crazy/mad about sb/sth. Olumsuzu kibar bir hoşnutsuzluk: "I'm not crazy about it." = pek bayılmıyorum.

sentences.en: She's [crazy about] him.
sentences.de: Sie ist verrückt nach ihm.

sentences.en: I'm not [crazy about] the idea, to be honest.
sentences.de: Ehrlich gesagt bin ich von der Idee nicht gerade begeistert.

meaning.en: to have romantic feelings towards someone

usage.en: have (strong/real) feelings for sb · still have feelings for · catch feelings (slang: to develop feelings unexpectedly)
usage.tr: have (strong/real) feelings for sb · still have feelings for · catch feelings (argo: beklenmedik biçimde hislenmek)

sentences.en: I think I still [have feelings for] my ex.
sentences.tr: Galiba eski sevgilime karşı hâlâ bir şeyler hissediyorum.
sentences.de: Ich glaube, ich habe immer noch Gefühle für meinen Ex.

sentences.en: I didn't realise I [had feelings for] him until he started dating someone else.
sentences.tr: Başkasıyla çıkmaya başlayana kadar ona karşı bir şeyler hissettiğimi fark etmemiştim.
sentences.de: Ich habe erst gemerkt, dass ich Gefühle für ihn habe, als er mit einer anderen zusammenkam.

meaning.en: to feel warm affection for someone or something (not necessarily romantic)
meaning.tr: birine/bir şeye sıcak bir sevgi duymak (romantik olmak zorunda değil)
meaning.de: warme Zuneigung für jemanden oder etwas empfinden (nicht unbedingt romantisch)

equivalent.de: jemanden gernhaben, jemanden mögen, an etwas hängen

register.en: neutral (a little soft; more common in BrE)

usage.en: be (very/quite) fond of sb/sth/V-ing · grow fond of
usage.tr: be (very/quite) fond of sb/sth/V-ing · grow fond of

sentences.en: I'm really [fond of] your sister — she's so easy to talk to.
sentences.tr: Kız kardeşini çok severim, onunla konuşmak çok kolay.
sentences.de: Ich mag deine Schwester wirklich gern – mit ihr kann man so gut reden.

sentences.en: I've grown quite [fond of] this place.
sentences.de: Dieser Ort ist mir richtig ans Herz gewachsen.

meaning.en: to consider someone or something important; to value them
meaning.de: jemanden oder etwas wichtig finden; Wert auf ihn legen

equivalent.de: jemandem wichtig sein, jemandem liegt etwas an jemandem

usage.en: care about sb/sth = to value · care for sb = to look after (or formal/old-fashioned: to love) · take care of = to look after, to deal with
usage.tr: care about sb/sth = önemsemek · care for sb = bakmak, bakımını üstlenmek (ya da resmî/eski: sevmek) · take care of = ilgilenmek, halletmek

sentences.en: I [care about] you — that's why I'm telling you this.
sentences.tr: Sana değer veriyorum, bunu o yüzden söylüyorum.
sentences.de: Du bist mir wichtig – deshalb sage ich dir das.

sentences.en: He acts tough, but he really [cares about] his friends.
sentences.tr: Sert görünür ama arkadaşlarına gerçekten değer verir.
sentences.de: Er tut hart, aber seine Freunde liegen ihm wirklich am Herzen.

meaning.en: to become emotionally bound to someone or something
meaning.de: eine gefühlsmäßige Bindung zu jemandem oder etwas aufbauen

equivalent.de: an jemandem hängen, sich an jemanden binden, jemanden ins Herz schließen

sentences.en: Don't [get too attached] — we're only fostering the dog for two weeks.
sentences.tr: Fazla bağlanma, köpeğe sadece iki hafta bakacağız.
sentences.de: Häng dein Herz nicht zu sehr an ihn – wir haben den Hund nur zwei Wochen in Pflege.

sentences.en: I [get attached to] people way too fast.
sentences.de: Ich hänge viel zu schnell an Menschen.

meaning.en: to get on very well from the first meeting
meaning.de: sich vom ersten Treffen an sehr gut verstehen

equivalent.tr: hemen kaynaşmak, elektrik almak, kanı kaynamak
equivalent.de: sich auf Anhieb verstehen, auf einer Wellenlänge sein

usage.en: hit it off (with sb) — "it" is fixed; usually past tense. For friendship as well as romance.
usage.tr: hit it off (with sb) — "it" sabit; genellikle geçmiş zaman. Arkadaşlık için de romantik için de.

sentences.en: We [hit it off] right away — we talked for like four hours.
sentences.tr: Hemen kaynaştık, dört saat falan konuştuk.
sentences.de: Wir haben uns auf Anhieb verstanden – wir haben bestimmt vier Stunden geredet.

sentences.en: I didn't really [hit it off] with his friends.
sentences.de: Mit seinen Freunden bin ich nicht so richtig warm geworden.

expressions.expr: get along with / get on with

meaning.en: to have a friendly relationship with someone
meaning.de: ein freundschaftliches Verhältnis zu jemandem haben

equivalent.de: sich mit jemandem gut verstehen, mit jemandem auskommen

variety.en: get along (with): AmE + BrE · get on (with): BrE
variety.tr: get along (with): AmE + BrE · get on (with): BrE

usage.en: get along/on (well) with sb · "We get along." (mutual) · get along great / don't get along
usage.tr: get along/on (well) with sb · "We get along." (karşılıklı) · get along great / don't get along

sentences.en: I [get along really well with] my roommates.
sentences.de: Ich verstehe mich richtig gut mit meinen Mitbewohnern.

sentences.en: She doesn't [get on with] her mother-in-law.
sentences.de: Sie kommt mit ihrer Schwiegermutter nicht aus.

meaning.en: of something you didn't like at first: to gradually become appealing
meaning.tr: başta sevilmeyen bir şeyin zamanla hoşa gitmeye başlaması
meaning.de: von etwas, das man anfangs nicht mochte: einem nach und nach gefallen

equivalent.de: jemandem mit der Zeit gefallen, jemandem ans Herz wachsen

literal.en: to grow on someone (slowly, like moss)
literal.tr: birinin üzerinde büyümek (yosun gibi yavaş yavaş)

usage.en: Subject = the thing/person being liked: "It's growing on me." ✗ I'm growing on it.
usage.tr: Özne = sevilen şey/kişi: "It's growing on me." ✗ I'm growing on it.

sentences.en: I didn't like the song at first, but it's [growing on me].
sentences.tr: Şarkıyı başta sevmemiştim ama dinledikçe sarıyor.
sentences.de: Am Anfang mochte ich das Lied nicht, aber es gefällt mir immer besser.

sentences.en: He's a bit weird, but he [grows on you].
sentences.de: Er ist ein bisschen seltsam, aber mit der Zeit mag man ihn.
